subject: [RFC PATCH v3 4/8] mm/gup: break out follow_one_pte() helper

2026-08-11.patch_summary: This patch breaks out a helper function called `follow_one_pte()` from the existing `follow_page_pte()` function in the Linux kernel's memory management code. The new helper function resolves one present PTE to the page it maps, returning no page and no error when the PTE cannot be followed but the caller may fault it in, or a negative errno when the caller must report the failure. This change is intended to simplify the `follow_page_pte()` function by reducing its complexity and making it easier to maintain. The patch does not introduce any functional changes and only modifies the code structure.
